title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Whitefield

content.rendered:
If you are sourcing a container office in Whitefield, you are buying direct from the manufacturer here. SAMAN Portable (SAMAN POS India Private Limited) builds steel container offices at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra (560099) and delivers ready-to-use units across the Whitefield IT corridor in east Bengaluru. You get a factory-built workspace, fixed specifications, and a single point of contact from quote to installation.

Container Offices for Sale in Whitefield

Container offices for sale in Whitefield are factory-built steel cabins delivered as finished, lockable workspaces for site offices, IT and startup teams, security posts, and project rooms. SAMAN Portable manufactures each unit on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, fits it out with wiring points, flooring, doors, and windows, then transports it to your Whitefield site for placement and connection.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard footprints. Each can be customised with extra windows, partitions, AC provision, toilet attachment, and electrical points to suit your team and site.

Size Typical footprint Best for
10ft Compact single cabin Security post, guard room, small site office
20ft Mid-size office Site office, 2–4 person team, project room
40ft Large office Multi-desk office, meeting plus workspace, combined cabins

Units can be placed side by side or stacked where the site and layout allow, so you can scale the workspace as your Whitefield operation grows.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying direct from the factory means no middleman and no marketplace mark-up. Every container office is built by SAMAN Portable on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, by a company holding ISO 9001:2015 certification. What that means for you:

  • Built to standard: MS steel frame and base manufactured to IS 2062, finished and inspected in-house.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Clear delivery terms: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit typically 3–5 days within the Bengaluru region.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.
  • One accountable maker: the team that builds the unit also quotes, delivers, and installs it.

To compare footprints and configurations, you can explore our full container office range and then request a quote for your Whitefield requirement.

Delivery and installation in Whitefield

Whitefield sits in the east Bengaluru IT and industrial corridor, well connected by the Outer Ring Road and Whitefield Main Road, with a steady mix of tech parks, construction sites, and commercial plots that need quick workspace. We deliver across Bengaluru, including Whitefield and the surrounding east-city neighbourhoods. Units leave our Gopasandra factory fully built; on arrival we position the cabin on your prepared base and hand it over ready for utility connection. Because the office is manufactured before it ships, your site disruption is minimal compared with on-site construction.

Get a container office quote in Whitefield

Tell us the size, layout, and where in Whitefield the unit needs to go, and we will share current pricing and a delivery timeline. Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry on the website. Pricing is shared on enquiry because it depends on size, customisation, and delivery distance — you can also browse current options on our container office range page.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in Whitefield?

We supply 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft container offices, with customisation such as partitions, extra windows, AC provision, and toilet attachment to match your Whitefield site and team size.


How long does delivery to Whitefield take?

Units are factory-built at our Gopasandra (Bengaluru) plant and transit is typically 3–5 days within the Bengaluru region, including Whitefield. Confirm the exact timeline when you request your quote.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. You can adjust the internal layout and add windows, partitions, electrical points, AC provision, and a toilet attachment. Share your requirement and we will configure the unit before manufacturing.


What warranty do SAMAN container offices carry?

Each unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The frame and base are built to IS 2062 by an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer.


How do I get a price for my Whitefield requirement?

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size and location details. Pricing depends on size, customisation, and delivery, so we confirm a current quote against your specific requirement.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
